waves.title: key.wave.1
waves.note: Rule (b) honoured: first wave <=40% of par (§1.7). Cold Start Minute (§1.9): the tick metronome wobbles harmlessly at 0:40-1:10 as the signature constraint's telegraph. Fraud weather arrives before players do — chargebacks are the season's first budget line.

waves.title: key.wave.2
waves.note: Rising floor beat one, and the slice's prime-time exemplar. Hard wave draws TWO fronts — bandwidth (booter) x reputation (mod day) — per §2.24. The booter is aimed at one clan; the box burns for everyone (§2.12).
waves.twoFrontCheck: bandwidth + reputation are two of the bundle's twoFrontDraw {bandwidth, concurrency, cash, reputation} (§2.24).

waves.title: key.wave.3
waves.note: Rule (c): 35% is 50% below the preceding peak (70%) — >=45% satisfied. The dip is where the player builds (§1.7): regional PoPs, scrubbing retainer. The spiral's seed was sown in wave 2 — servers that emptied during the booter week now repel rejoins (full attracts, empty repels, §3.3 herding).
waves.entropyNote: entropy budget here = f(estate age x size x (1 - maintenance spend)), NOT wave number (§2.24).

waves.title: key.wave.4
waves.note: Every-4th-wave NEW ROLE beat: Tank (UDP amplification barrage) and Mimic (cheat client) both debut here — unseen in waves 1-3. Hard wave draws exactly TWO fronts — bandwidth (barrage + booter) x reputation (cheat client) (§2.1 Two-Front Law / §2.24). UDP cannot simply be dropped — it IS the game (§1.3).
waves.secondIncident: the barrage lands while the cheat crackdown is still hot -> 1.8x during-incident multiplier applies (stated openly in the Codex, §2.24).

waves.title: key.wave.5
waves.note: Launch window finale. WIN CONDITION per §1.3: end the level with cash intact after the hype resolves — the trap is buying 40 servers at the peak. Hard wave draws exactly TWO fronts — bandwidth (the flagship booter-follows-the-streamer beat, §2.12 Competitor-Sponsored Attack demoted to codex flavour ON this entry, R36) x data-integrity (the Friday-patch exemplar: mod-update-day at prime time — handover 'A Friday patch, prime time'). The launch flood's concurrency and the speculation's cash exposure ride the demand envelope, NOT the attack budget — par is threat pressure only (§1.7).
waves.envelopeOverlap: launch-window-0001 rides this wave — par is the ATTACK budget; the demand multiplier is composed on top (§1.7: events are shaped envelopes over baseline, budgets stay separate).
